subject.title: feat(mattermost): auto-engage on replies to the bot's own thread

question: Should Mattermost reply-to-bot thread-root engagement ship on by default, without a new config option, after live proof or an explicit proof waiver?
rationale: The implementation fits the plugin boundary, but it changes when Mattermost sends agent replies under existing mention/onchar policy and the PR has a protected maintainer label.

options.title: Accept Default-On Parity
options.body: Merge after exact-head checks and either a live Mattermost roundtrip or an explicit maintainer waiver, matching Slack/Telegram reply-to-bot behavior.

options.title: Make Reply-To-Bot Opt-In
options.body: Require a Mattermost config or policy choice before bot-root thread replies bypass explicit mentions.

options.title: Pause For Broader Thread Policy
options.body: Hold this PR until Mattermost participated-thread and reply-to-bot behavior are reviewed as one channel policy.

recommendation.title: Accept Default-On Parity
recommendation.body: Merge after exact-head checks and either a live Mattermost roundtrip or an explicit maintainer waiver, matching Slack/Telegram reply-to-bot behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The history pass points to steipete as the strongest adjacent owner for channel policy and implicit mention semantics.
